question: ________ was the Buddhist monument built by Emperor Ashoka in Madhya Pradesh to honor Lord Buddha.
solution:
The correct answer is **Sanchi Stupa**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanchi Stupa is the Buddhist monument built by Emperor Ashoka in Madhya Pradesh** to honor Lord Buddha.
 
• It is one of the oldest stone **structures in India and was originally commissioned by Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE.**
 
• Sanchi Stupa is famous for its **grand structure and the exquisite carvings that depict various events of the Buddha’s life.​**
